name: Presidio Golf Course
location: Presidio of San Francisco, San Francisco, California
architects: opened 1895 (nine holes, San Francisco Golf and Country Club); 18 holes 1910; enlarged by Fowler & Simpson (London), 1920 (club history page)

dtm.source: bare earth from the ground points (class 2) of the 2023 USGS Lidar: San Francisco Bay Area (NOAA Data Access Viewer dataset 10172, job J1476298), flown 20 April 2023 (GPS times), gridded to 1 m in EPSG:32610 by pipeline/intake.py dtm; NAVD88 m; GitHub release assorted-lidar-data, ca2023_sanfran_J1476298.zip (ground class only)

world.note: OSM course boundary (way 16650363) bbox 1,211 x 748 m in UTM 10N + ~120 m scenery, whole 256 m chunks, centred: 1,536 m east-west (162 m each side), 1,024 m north-south (138 m each side)

scorecard_source: The club's card (presidiogolf.com, PGC-Scorecard.pdf, March 2026), read 2026-10-25: Black, White, Blue and Red per hole, par 72, men's and women's stroke index (its back-nine index rows are shifted one cell, read with hole 10 = 10 as GolfPass prints it), ratings for every set and combo. Black 11 is 419 (GolfPass; the card's printed totals 3,306 / 6,481 need 419). Played from the tips, Black 6,481 yd, 72.5/136 (developer, 2026-10-25: "for all of these courses lets play from the tips"). The other sets are in scorecard.csv but not built.
attribution: Elevation: U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program (2023 San Francisco Bay Area lidar), via NOAA Digital Coast
notes: Course chat, 2026-10-25: not scouted; the developer added the lidar to assorted-lidar-data. Standing defaults (every penalty area red, OSM boundary as OB, trees from the 2023 lidar's class 1 (the survey has no vegetation classes), roofs dropped on OSM's building footprints (the April flight is not leaf-off, so roof_last_share doesn't apply)). Played from the tips: Black (developer, 2026-10-25: "for all of these courses lets play from the tips"). Wind 3-12 mph: a sheltered, wooded site above the Golden Gate (between the bay band and the open coast). Theme presidio: the course's own, from the developer's photos (developer: a new theme for each course).

laz.source: 2023 USGS Lidar: San Francisco Bay Area (NOAA Data Access Viewer job J1476365, all classes: the survey has no vegetation classes, so trees come from class 1, processed but unclassified), flown 20 April 2023 (GPS times); NAD83(2011) / California zone 3, NAVD88 m; GitHub release assorted-lidar-data, ca2023_sanfran_J1476365.zip (developer, 2026-10-25), clipped to the world + 100 m with pipeline/intake.py laz
laz.label: 2023 USGS San Francisco Bay Area lidar
laz.max_height_note: returns more than 60 m above the ground are high noise left in class 1 (some reached 113 m over the eucalyptus); the canopy's own heights tail off by 55-60 m

drop_trees.reason: course chat 2026-10-25: a 24 m crown 11.6 m wide 69 m out from the 17th's Black tee, 5 m off the line; its canopy reached a perfect tee shot at the middle of the fairway 60 m out, just past s06b's 60 m reach (course_play.test.ts, the every-course rule)
